_doc: Map storefront product slugs → Good Smile Company product-page URLs.
The Good Smile adapter fetches the URL, parses the JSON-LD Product
block + the on-page spec list, and pulls the figure gallery.
(the trailing /<name> path segment is optional — GSC serves by id)
An empty string is a scaffold placeholder: the slug is staged but no
URL has been filled in yet. Empty entries are inert — the adapter
skips them — so it's safe to commit the scaffold and fill URLs over
These are all EXISTING storefront rows (status='available') that are
missing images / description, so there is no `line` field and no
draft creation — the adapter only proposes data for review.
